message.content: {"skill": {"name": "Bar Path and Lockout Fault Check", "description": "Inspect the ascent of a press attempt for downward bar movement and verify full arm extension with a motionless bar at the top. Use when judging press-phase faults or resolving lockout disputes.", "prompt": "Apply this micro-check only to the press-phase bar path and lockout question. Review the ascent for any downward movement of the whole bar, then verify arms are fully extended and the bar is held motionless at the top before the rack command. Treat automated overlay thresholds as advisory only; do not let a sub-threshold reading override a visible fault.
